Usage:
  msgvault calendar create <calendar-id> [flags]

Flags:
      --all-day                date-only event; --to is the exclusive end date
      --attendees strings      replace guest email list (comma-separated; empty clears)
      --description string     event description
      --from string            start: RFC3339, or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with --tz
  -h, --help                   help for create
      --location string        event location
      --reminder stringArray   popup:minutes, email:minutes, default, or none (repeatable)
      --rrule stringArray      recurrence RRULE (repeatable; empty clears)
      --summary string         event title (explicit empty clears on update)
      --to string              end: RFC3339, or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with --tz
      --tz string              IANA time zone for local times and recurrence

Inherited Flags:
      --account string        configured calendar source name or OAuth account (required)
      --dry-run               verify access and print the proposed changes without writing
      --json                  print the complete result and archive receipts as JSON
      --read-only             forbid every event mutation
      --send-updates string   guest notifications: none, all, or externalOnly (default "none")

Global Flags: --agent-allow-insecure, --agent-token-file, --agent-url, --config, --home, --local, --log-file, --log-level, --log-sql, --log-sql-slow-ms, --no-log-file, -v/--verbose (see 'msgvault --help')
